note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Chhotani (1997); original in English; alates unknown; soldiers and workers (major and minor) described; measurements taken from the text; literature citations, distribution and figure numbers not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule golden yellow; rostrum pale reddish brown, darker apically, transparent at the tip; antennae and pronotum pale golden brown; abdomen pale yellow. Head sparsely setose, body moderately setose; anterior abdominal tergites and sternites with setae and several long setae. Body length 3.3–3.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, slightly wider than long; length including rostrum 1.55–1.63, length excluding rostrum 0.89–0.95, maximum width 0.95–1.05 mm; in profile nearly straight, without a hump. Rostrum long, conical, 0.62–0.68 mm long; rostrum length to head length ratio 0.67–0.76. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 about as long as segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, without spine-like processes. Postmentum subrectangular; length and maximum width about equal (length 0.30–0.33, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm). Pronotum small, saddle-shaped (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.48–0.50 mm). Mesonotum as wide as pronotum, metanotum wider.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule, antennae and labrum yellowish brown; thorax and legs pale yellow; abdomen pale milky white. Head and body rather densely setose. Body length 3.4–4.1 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long (length to base of mandibles 0.95–1.05, maximum width 1.08–1.15 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segments 3 and 5 about equal; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.27–0.30, width 0.52–0.55 mm). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but overall smaller, body length 2.8–3.0 mm, head length to base of mandibles 0.80–0.81 mm, maximum head width 0.92–0.93 mm, pronotum length 0.13–0.15 mm, width 0.33–0.35 mm.
